title: Gardening & Yard Maintenance | Rosa's Sparkling Clean & Management
metaDescription: Lawn care, hedge trimming and yard cleanup that keeps curb appeal from lapsing on listed and vacant properties in Ocala, Tampa and Spring Hill, FL.
h1: Curb appeal is the first showing, whether anyone's watching or not.
intro: An overgrown yard is the first sign a property's been sitting empty. We keep lawns cut, hedges shaped and beds cleared so the outside matches the work happening inside.
heroImageAlt: A landscaper trimming a manicured hedge in a home's front yard
whatsappMessage: Hi, I'd like to ask about your gardening service

sections.heading: Who it's for
sections.body: Vacant properties that need a recurring schedule so the yard never gives away that no one's home, and sellers who want the exterior photo-ready.

evidence.heading: See the difference
evidence.alt: Before and after comparison of a front yard: overgrown patchy grass and untrimmed hedges on the left, a manicured green lawn with trimmed hedges and mulched beds on the right
evidence.caption: Same yard, one visit — the kind of curb appeal that gets a second look.
